## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `27657d802c42d48d0a12c78cd7ad20278ff13c21`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs (`SEAT_SHAPE`, `RESERVED_DOMAIN_LANE`, `seatKey`, `mailboxBranch`, `MAILBOX_OF_LINE`, `mailboxOwner`, `openMailboxesOf`), scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs (`isEpicParent`, `buildRows` epic loop, `unassignedMailboxes`, `renderBody`, `readsFor`, `readLive`), scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json, scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs (`readSeat`, `readMailboxLine` — read, not reviewed), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`EPIC_REGISTRATION_MARKER`, `h45DelegationNodeSignals`, `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` — read), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md and references/seat-lifecycle.md 〈Epic 子树车道〉 (read), scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs `GOVERNED_SURFACES` (read, for ③). The remainder of the diff (the two scripts and the fixture as code) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

Inputs: card #28718 body and all four comments (triage 6560301001, state 6560747188, claim 6560767706, dev report 6561170948); PR #28751 body, file list (4 files, +109/−43) and `git diff origin/main...27657d80`; the check-runs on `27657d80` read from GitHub. Read-only: nothing checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- `seatKey` accept-set widens by exactly `epic:#N` / `epic:#N#K` (`SEAT_SHAPE` gains `epic:#[1-9][0-9]*`, same digit shape as `check-half-states` `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE`); key keeps the spelling, slug `epic-N-K` via `/:#?/g`. **Right.** Malformed epic spellings (`epic:27293`, `epic:#0`, `epic:#012`, `epic:#12#1#2`, `epic:skills#1`) stay null; the old pin `seatKey('epic:#12') === null` is replaced by `epic:#12#1`, which is the card's Wanted ①.
- Reserved set widens by `domain:epic-…` so the slug stays one-to-one (`domain:epic-12#1` would slug to `epic-12-1`). **Right**, and narrow: `domain:epic`, `domain:epics`, `domain:epic#12` (slug `epic-12`, two segments) and `repo:epic-12` (slug `repo-epic-12-1`) still read. I tried `epic:#1#21` vs `epic:#12#1`, `triage#12`, `domain:12#1`: distinct slugs. No `domain:epic*` label exists today.
- New public exports: `SEAT_EPIC_KIND` (consumed by fleet-roster, built into both regexes) and `isEpicParent` (self-test). **Right.** `--seat` refusal prose now gives an epic example. **Right.**
- Every reader of the seat grammar through `seatKey` accepts epic seats without an edit: record-recognisers `readMailboxLine` (`To:` line) and `readSeat` (key fields; `lastIndexOf('#')` splits `epic:#27293#1` into lane `epic:#27293`, n 1 — read, correct), `mailboxOwner` (`MAILBOX_OF_LINE` takes `\S+`), `openMailboxesOf` (slug match). **Right**, and intended by the card.
- fleet-roster: one new read per repo (`issues?state=open&labels=pm:epic`, in `readsFor` and `readLive`); a row per open delegated `pm:epic` parent, seats = open mailboxes whose body line names `epic:#N#K`, else seat 1 unknown; `cardLaneMatch` stays false for epic lanes (no in-flight, no rulings); `suspectedWall` forced off for epic rows; summary line reads `N seat rows (K epic)`; orphan text `no seat post or epic parent carries this seat`. **Right.** No other file consumes the two changed strings (grep on main).
- A closed epic never becomes a row (query is `state=open`, and the loop guards `state === 'closed'`); an undelegated parent (no registration, or no sub-issue) is no row; a mailbox of either is listed under the table (fixture 25398 → `epic:#28130#1`). The brief's three probes — a slugging collision, a closed or undelegated epic shown live, a `To: epic:…` mis-read — all hold.
- `isEpicParent` is byte-equal to H45's two halves (`EPIC_REGISTRATION_MARKER` = `/session_[A-Za-z0-9]{4,}/`, `sub_issues_summary.total > 0`), re-spelled rather than imported so the relay never loads the patrol; the self-test pins the equality over the fixture. **Right.**
- Check-runs on `27657d80`: the runs that had concluded when this record was written are all `success` or `skipped` (Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, PR-body guards, Dogfood Regression Gate, tooling self-tests, Type Check workspace/debt ledger, Test UI, Plan Test Core shards, Auto Label, filter); at the time of this write every check-run on the head has completed — 46 runs, 26 `success`, 20 `skipped`, 0 failure, none pending (Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI/release/engine gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · ESLint, Type Check · source/consumer gates, Test Core 1/8 and 2/8 among the successes). Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was re-run here.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` on the PR body and in the claim; label `skip-changeset`; Check Changeset `success`. The diff publishes nothing — `scripts/pm/**` and `.claude/**` are outside every package — so no changeset is owed and no `(narrowing)` arm applies. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (report 6561170948), each answered:
1. First gate pass before `pnpm install` (nine exit 3, one exit 1) then all 38 re-ran to 0 after install/build under the lock — environment, nothing measured; the CI check-runs are the gate verdicts here. Accepted.
2. First `check:pm-dispatch-gates` run backgrounded without exit capture, re-run with exit 0 recorded. Accepted.
3. The 〈信箱 PR〉 rule is one EDITED line, the file at ceiling 54/54, paid by dropping the branch spelling `mailbox/LOGIN/SLUG`. Accepted — see ④: the branch is tool-owned and the rule still names the tool.
4. PR body footer is the order's `🤖 Generated with …` line, not AGENTS' session-URL footer. Not a hits file; the PR-body guards check is green. Noted for the owning seat; a relay `pr_create` template matter, not this diff.
5. PR opened with no assignee though AGENTS says the PR assignee mirrors the card's. Noted; the executor sets it at `pr_create`, no seat writes it by hand. Not blocking.

`open_questions`, both answered:
- Q1 (uniform seat line on epic parents?) — **A, keep.** The lane's delegation signal (`pm:epic` + a session in the body, seat-lifecycle 〈Epic 子树车道〉) says delegated, not currently seated; #8345 carries a registration and says vacant in prose. `unknown` is the honest reading and the open mailbox is exactly the ringable signal the card is about. A machine seat line on epic bodies is a seat-lifecycle protocol change — a card of its own if ever wanted, outside this file surface.
- Q2 (which record lands this PR?) — **A, Tier S.** `GOVERNED_SURFACES` row `claude-tree` (`.claude/**`) is `GOVERNED_TIER_S` for `objectstack`; AGENTS §14 says Tier S is all of `.claude/**`; `scripts/pm/**` is on no register row. Triage's "Tier H for the skill line" is an audit remark, not a ruling and not the register. This record, with a PASS and every check green, is the landing record; the owning seat lands it through the queue.

Reviewer disclosure: this record is rendered by a contract-review subagent inside the `domain:skills#2` seat session that dispatched the dev (Implemented-by is the dev's branch, Reviewed-by the seat session — the branch/session independence pair, per the record template).

### ④ Design judgment

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 line 36 — judged against the card's Wanted ③ ("one rules line says an epic seat opens a mailbox like any seat"), the spec it teaches on `main` (seat-lifecycle 〈Epic 子树车道〉, the epic lane SKILL.md names) and the cited code on the head:

- The claim "epic 席 … 同样开" (the line spells the seat as `epic:#N#K`, the parent number as an angle-bracket placeholder) holds against the code: `mailbox-open.mjs --seat epic:#27293#1 --login L` parses, plans branch `mailbox/L/epic-27293-1`, body first line `Mailbox-of: epic:#27293#1 · L`, title `pm:mailbox — epic:#27293#1 · L`, passes `validateStroke`; `mailboxOwner` reads it back by body and by head; a second open for the same seat is refused, another epic's or `domain:epic`'s is not; the roster shows it on the parent's row. The rule and its gate agree.
- Dropping the branch spelling `分支 mailbox/LOGIN/SLUG` loses nothing a seat acts on: line 37 still sends the seat to `mailbox-open.mjs`, which owns `mailboxBranch` and `MAILBOX_BRANCH_PREFIX`, and fleet-roster imports both rather than re-spelling them; no other skill file carried the branch form (grep on main). This is the AGENTS "stated once, the script's header is the authority on detail" shape. Line count 54/54 unchanged, the line 115 bytes; `check-skill-id-lint`'s `/#[0-9]{3,}/` sees no number on the line.
- Breaking attempts: `epic:#N` alone reads as seat 1, as the line's `#K` implies for every lane; `To: epic:#27293#1` on the mailbox reads (record-recognisers through `seatKey`); the seat signature spelling on epic cards (`epic:#27293#1 · login · session`) is the same string, so a seat can copy it verbatim into `--seat`. Nothing in the line contradicts the roster's reading (seat K = the open mailbox's `Mailbox-of:` key).

Findings — no must-fix:
- should-fix (project-forms line 36): the placeholder pair is mixed — the parent number in angle brackets, the seat number a bare `K` — while the rest of the file spells every placeholder in angle brackets (席位, login, slug). Bracketing `k` the same way is 117 bytes, under the cap; a reader could take `K` as a literal.
- should-fix (fleet-roster `buildRows` epic loop, cited code): `held` reads only mailboxes whose BODY names the seat (`m.seat`); an epic mailbox named by head slug alone (`mailbox/L/epic-27293-1`, no `Mailbox-of:` line — a hand-made one) shows in the row's mailbox column (slug match) while the row reads `? —`. Matching `held` by slug (`epic-N-K`) as the mailbox column does would make the two readings agree; the opener always writes the body line, so no live mailbox hits this today.
- should-fix (fleet-roster `isEpicParent`, cited code): a freshly delegated parent (registration, no sub-issue filed yet) has no row, so the mailbox its PM opened at seating is listed under the table as "no seat post or epic parent carries this seat" until the first child is filed — a transient false flag with a wording that is false for that parent. The PR's Acceptance notes name the choice (H45's both halves); either a registration-only row or a wording that says "no delegated epic parent" closes it.
- noted, not a finding of this diff: the `epic:#N` lane is not repo-qualified (the signature grammar's own shape), so a mailbox for `epic:#N#1` attaches to every open delegated parent numbered N across the repos read; the PR names it, no two live parents collide today.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-28718-epic-seat-mailbox`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ed0cc244e46a68611333a6d2b1e0e36bcd3d7a5f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md + scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs (`isEpicParent`, `isEpicRegistered`, `isSeatedFreshEpic`, `epicSeatsHeld`, `buildRows` epic loop, `unassignedMailboxes`), scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json, scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs (`seatKey`, `mailboxOwner` — unchanged since the prior head, read), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs (`EPIC_REGISTRATION_MARKER`, `h45DelegationNodeSignals`, `epicCardNamesParent` — read). The remainder of the diff (the two scripts and the fixture as code) is the lane seat's ACCEPT at TIER_DEFAULT.

This record supersedes 6561348241 (head `27657d80`) for the PR's current head. Inputs: card #28718 body and comments through the patch report 6561503444; PR #28751 body, file list (4 files, +141/−43 vs `main`), `git diff 27657d80..ed0cc244` (3 files, +49/−17) and the full net diff vs `main`; the check-runs on `ed0cc244` read from GitHub. Read-only: nothing checked out, built or run.

### ① Derived judgments

- `mailbox-open.mjs` is byte-identical to the prior head: every ① judgment of 6561348241 on `seatKey`, the reserved set, the exports and the readers through `seatKey` stands.
- fleet-roster epic loop: the parent guard moves below the mailbox read and becomes `isEpicParent(epic) || isSeatedFreshEpic(epic, held)`; `held` is now `epicSeatsHeld(lane, mailboxes)`, matched by slug `epic-N-K` (body line or head alike) with every candidate round-tripped through `seatKey` (`seatKey(lane#k).slug === m.slug`). **Right.** Accept-set change: a head-only epic mailbox now seats its row; a registered `pm:epic` issue with no sub-issue yet becomes a row once a mailbox names it. Both are the two should-fixes asked for.
- `isEpicParent` is unchanged in meaning (`sub_issues > 0 && isEpicRegistered`), still byte-equal to H45's two halves, now pinned over six fixture cards. **Right.** `isEpicRegistered` is private; `isSeatedFreshEpic` and `epicSeatsHeld` are new exports consumed only by the self-test. **Right.**
- Fixture: 28800 (registered, total 0) + mailbox 25399 (`Mailbox-of: epic:#28800#2`) → one seated row, not flagged; 25400 (head `mailbox/os-bill/epic-27293-2`, empty body) → 27293 seat 2 seated by `os-bill`; 28647 (child: registration, total 0, no mailbox) stays no row; orphans unchanged at three (25395, 25396, 25398 — the closed-or-unlisted epic 28130). Summary line `(4 epic)`. **Right.**
- Check-runs on `ed0cc244`: at the time of this write every run has completed — 41 runs, 25 `success`, 16 `skipped`, 0 failure, none pending; Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, tooling self-tests, PR-body guards, Test Core shards all `success`. Those conclusions are the gate verdicts; nothing was re-run here.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from 6561348241: `Clause-②: no`, `skip-changeset`, nothing published from `scripts/pm/**` or `.claude/**`; no `(narrowing)` arm. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

The patch report carries no deviations and no `open_questions`. The prior round's five deviations and two answers (Q1 A keep; Q2 A Tier S — `GOVERNED_SURFACES` `claude-tree` is Tier S for objectstack) stand unchanged. The PR body's acceptance bullet "a delegated parent with no sub-issue filed yet gets no row" is now stale against the tree; the owning seat corrects it in the ACCEPT, not a finding here.

Reviewer disclosure as before: rendered by a contract-review subagent inside the `domain:skills#2` seat session; Implemented-by the dev's branch, Reviewed-by the seat session.

### ④ Design judgment

`project-forms.md` 〈信箱 PR〉 line 36 — the seat is now spelled with both numbers as angle-bracket placeholders, matching the file's own placeholder convention; 54/54 lines, the line 117 bytes, no 3+-digit number for `check-skill-id-lint`. The claim "an epic seat opens one like any seat" holds against the unchanged opener exactly as judged on `27657d80`, and now also against the roster for a head-only mailbox. **Should-fix 1 resolved.**

Cited code, each prior should-fix against the new head:
- **Should-fix 2 resolved.** `epicSeatsHeld` derives the stem `epic-N-` from `seatKey(lane).slug` (trailing `1` of `-1` stripped; a parent number ending in 1 keeps its digit since only the final char goes), then accepts a mailbox only when `seatKey('epic:#N#k').slug` reproduces its slug. Tried: `epic-27293-0`, `epic-27293-01`, `epic-27293-1-2` (k fails `seatKey`, dropped); `epic-272931-1` against stem `epic-27293-` (no prefix match, the stem ends in `-`); `epic-2864-7-1` against `epic-2864-` (k `7-1` refused). Body-named and head-only mailboxes read through the same slug, so the row and its mailbox column can no longer disagree.
- **Should-fix 3 resolved.** `isSeatedFreshEpic` is registration AND a held seat — never registration alone (a child has a registration too) and never a mailbox alone (an unregistered parent with a stray mailbox stays an orphan flag). A parent delegated before its first sub-issue is a seated row the moment its PM opens the mailbox, which is the seating act the rule prescribes.
- Breaking attempts on the new conditions: a closed epic is never listed (`state=open` query plus the guard), so its mailbox stays under the table — no closed epic reads live; an undelegated parent with sub-issues and no registration stays no row even with a mailbox; a child shares no number pattern with its parent's seats (the stem's trailing `-` and the `seatKey` round-trip see to it). A `pm:epic` child becomes a row only if a mailbox is opened under the child's own number — a mis-typed `--seat` the opener cannot see (it reads no card), and the row is then at least visible rather than an orphan line; the list-issues read carries no parent field to guard on (H45 reads the parent separately), so this stays a noted limitation, not a finding. Cross-repo attachment is as before: `epic:#N` is not repo-qualified by the signature grammar, named in the PR, no live collision.

Findings: none — no must-fix, no should-fix.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-28718-epic-seat-mailbox`
Reviewed-by: `session_017ihL2g7RyXa8ErM6GAkHyc`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(席位终稿 · head `ed0cc244e46a68611333a6d2b1e0e36bcd3d7a5f`)

- **改了什么**:epic 席(`epic:#<n>#<k>`,如 `epic:#27293#1`)现在能用 `mailbox-open.mjs` 开信箱,花名册 `fleet-roster.mjs` 给每个已委派的 `pm:epic` 父卡出一行;〈信箱 PR〉规则一行写明 epic 席同样开信箱。
- **为什么改**:epic PM 席派发全部 `pm:epic` 卡,却没有信箱、也不上花名册,别的席位无法敲它(#28675 实测;triage 的「先做 #28591」就这样搁在卡上)。
- **风险与回滚**:只动 PM 工具脚本与一行规则,无产品代码、无包发布(`skip-changeset`)。花名册每仓多一次只读 GET。回滚 = revert。
- **先看**:`scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` `seatKey`;`scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs` `buildRows` 的 epic 循环。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs --repo o/r --seat 'epic:#27293#1' --login x --dry-run` 退出 0;`node scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs --self-test` 全过。
- **需要你做的**:批准本 PR(`.claude/**` 规则变更以你的批准为裁决)。契约复审 PASS:6561551606(`Head-sha: ed0cc244e46a68611333a6d2b1e0e36bcd3d7a5f`)。

**席位意见:ACCEPT.**

## 席位核对

- **形态:** 4 files, +141/−43 vs `main`: `mailbox-open.mjs` (seat grammar gains the epic lane; `domain:epic-…` reserved so slugs stay one-to-one), `fleet-roster.mjs` + fixture (epic rows, `epicSeatsHeld`, `isSeatedFreshEpic`), `project-forms.md` one line edited (54/54, 117 bytes). `skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- **复审:** `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS 6561348241 (first head `27657d802c`, 0 must-fix, 3 should-fix) → patch round (delta report 6561503444) → delta PASS 6561551606 on `ed0cc244e46a68611333a6d2b1e0e36bcd3d7a5f`, 0 must-fix, 0 should-fix, each prior should-fix judged resolved against the tree.
- **门禁:** dev's `dispatch-gates --commands` 38/38 exit 0, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED, both rounds. Check-runs on `ed0cc244`: 0 failure, none pending (record 6561551606).
- **open_questions:** Q1 → A (no new epic seat line; an open mailbox is the ringable signal, `unknown` shows the gap). Q2 → Tier S (`.claude/**` by the register), plus the card-level condition used for #28642/#28675/#28699: the maintainer's approval is the ruling for a rule change.
- **PR 正文更正:** the body's acceptance bullet saying a delegated parent with no sub-issue gets no row is superseded by the patch round: such a parent gets a row once its PM has opened a mailbox named after it (`isSeatedFreshEpic`); with no mailbox it still gets none. This record is the correction (the relay does not patch PR bodies).
- **接受的偏差:** PR footer is the 🤖 form with the session in body prose; no PR assignee — as on #28739.
- **范围外去向:** `record-recognisers.mjs` `readSeat` docblock names four lanes in prose (behaviour already follows `seatKey`) — noted, not filed (doc-only, next card that touches the file). `Skills-docs: none — internal tooling`.
- **落地条款:** draft with `needs-user-decision` until an authorised approver acts; then the seat clears the label, flips ready and enqueues.
